description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F395222
Sheriff’s File # 24000762
PLAINTIFF – DEFINED CAPITAL, LLC vs:
DEFENDANTS- David Findel, et al
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 22nd day of June, 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Colts Neck, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Block 16, Lot 61.01 Tax Map of the Township of Colts Neck
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
104 Cedar Drive Colts Neck, NJ 07722
Dimensions: (approximately) Irregular
Number of Feet to Nearest Cross Street: Walnut Grove
This concise statement does not constitute a legal description.
Prior liens and encumbrances not extinguished by sale:
Open tax quarters and unpaid municipal charges due and owing to the Township of Colts Neck as of April 30, 2026: NONE
Tax Sale Certificate #24-00006: $30,176.11 as of April 30, 2026
The full legal description can be found in the Office of the Clerk of Monmouth County in Book OR-8403 at page 6030.
Approximate upset amount: $123,000.00
Property is VACANT LAND.
SUBJECT TO ADMINISTRATIVE CONSENT ORDER RECORDED ON APRIL 3, 2019, AT BOOK OR-9342, PAGE 474 AND ISSUED TO DAVID FINDEL PURSUANT TO THE FRESHWATER WETLANDS PROTECTION ACT N.J.S.A 13:9B-1 et seq, NJSA 13:9B-21g THE FLOOD HAZARD AREA CONTROL ACT NJSA 58:16A-63(g) AND HIGHLANDS WATER PROTECTION PLANNING ACT NJSA 13:20-35. SUBJECT TO NOTICE OF ATTACHMENT VIOLATION RECORDED ON FEBRUARY 13, 2007, AT BOOK OR-8629, PAGE 9757.
SUBJECT TO CORRECTION OF FRESHWATER WETLANDS PROTECTION ACT, THE FLOOD HAZARD AREA CONTROL ACT AND ANY OTHER VIOLATIONS AT PROPERTY AS REQUIRED BY THE STATE OF NEW JESEY DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $111,622.38.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: April 28, 2026
Gary C. Zeitz, LLC
1101 Laurel Oak Road Suite 170
Voorhees, NJ 08043
(856) 857-1222
